compute_least_core_value: compute the least core value of a coalitional game using stochastic saddle point optimization
payoff_evaluation: evaluate the maximum coalition deficit for a given payoff vector and epsilon-core approximation
run_CoreOptimization_solve: run CoreOptimization to find an epsilon-core payoff vector via gradient descent over payoffs
run_CoreOptimizationLogits_solve: run CoreOptimizationLogits to find an epsilon-core payoff vector via gradient descent over logits
